title: Osorkon IV
summary: King listed in CFAH-10 Table 3 (Egypt Dynasty 22).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 22. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-10 (Table 3, "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 22").
